# shenzhen-beach.com
> A comprehensive single-page guide to all 10 beaches in Shenzhen, China. Interactive map, comparison tool, transport guides, real photos, honest reviews. Everything you need to find your perfect Shenzhen beach day.

## Main Page
- [Complete Guide](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/): One page that covers every Shenzhen beach.
  - #quiz — Hero + quick filter: find your beach match by activity (Swimming, Surfing, Family, Camping, Photography)
  - #map — Interactive Leaflet map with all 10 beaches color-coded by crowd level
  - #compare — Side-by-side comparison table of all beaches (distance, fee, rating, crowds)
  - #beaches — Cards for each beach: transport, facilities, features, visitor tips
  - #transport — Metro, bus, taxi, and driving options to reach the beaches
  - #seasons — Spring/summer/autumn/winter guide with temperatures and best activities
  - #foreign — International visitor info: payment, visa, language cards, beach etiquette
  - #faq — 8 frequently asked questions with inline links to relevant sections

## Beach Detail Pages
- [Dameisha Beach (大梅沙)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/dameisha): Free public beach, Metro Line 8 access, best for families and first-timers.
- [Xichong Beach (西涌)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/xichong): Longest beach, best surf in the region, cleanest water. 30 RMB entry.
- [Xiaomeisha Beach (小梅沙)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/xiaomeisha): Resort beach with paid entry, upscale facilities, family-friendly.
- [Dongchong Beach (东涌)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/dongchong): Quiet beach with hiking trail to Xichong, surfable waves. 20 RMB entry.
- [Yangmeikeng Beach (杨梅坑)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/yangmeikeng): Scenic cycling path, photography hotspot, free entry.
- [Jinshawan Beach (金沙湾)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/jinshawan): Luxury resort beach, quiet, free entry.
- [Judiaosha Beach (桔钓沙)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/judiaosha): Crescent bay, white sand, romantic escape, free entry.
- [Nanao Beach (南澳沙滩)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/nanao): Local fishing town atmosphere, seafood focus, free entry.
- [Shuitousha Beach (水头沙)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/shuitousha): Small secluded beach, peaceful atmosphere, free entry.
- [Shangdong Beach (上洞)](https://www.shenzhen-beach.com/beaches/shangdong): Off-path local beach, undeveloped and quiet, free entry.
